description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Private Pool* 6 Seater Golf cart included with your reservation — no deposit required* 0.6 Miles to Beach Highlands Beach Access* Pet-friendly ($250 Fee and Restrictions Apply)* Enjoy 6 Fun Pug Bikes —perfect for exploring the area at your own pace* Multiple covered outdoor balconies plus a summer kitchen with built-in refrigerator for entertaining* Master suite retreat with a freestanding soaking tub, dual rain showerheads, floating vanity, oversized closet, and a private balcony* Prime 30A Location – Just minutes from Dune Allen Beach, Topsail Hill Preserve State Park, and the shops, restaurants, and entertainment at Gulf Place Town Center.* Professional Management: Rest assured with 24/7 service for a seamless experience* This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Spotted Dolphin, a stunning newly built luxury beach home completed in 2025, located in the desirable Beach Highlands community on the peaceful west end of Scenic Highway 30A. With 8 bedrooms, 9 bathrooms, and over 5,200 square feet of beautifully designed living space, this exceptional three-story retreat is the perfect destination for family reunions, group vacations, and unforgettable beach getaways. Step inside to discover bright, open living spaces featuring soaring 12-foot ceilings, abundant natural light, and a sleek electric fireplace that creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. The chef's kitchen is a dream for preparing meals, complete with premium white GE Café appliances, beautiful pecky cypress accents, ample counter space, and everything you need to cook for a crowd. Designed with comfort and privacy in mind, each of the eight spacious bedrooms includes its own private ensuite bathroom, allowing every guest to enjoy their own personal retreat. The luxurious primary suite offers a spa-inspired ensuite featuring a freestanding soaking tub, dual rain showerheads, a floating vanity, a large walk-in closet, and private balcony access. A second-floor flex space provides an additional living area with a dry bar, giving families and groups extra room to relax, play games, or enjoy movie nights together. After a day at the beach, unwind on one of the multiple covered balconies or fire up the outdoor summer kitchen, complete with a built-in refrigerator, making it easy to entertain while enjoying the coastal breeze. Whether you're spending your days soaking up the sun on nearby 30A beaches or relaxing in this beautifully appointed home, Spotted Dolphin offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and space for your next coastal escape.Bed Setup:2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed (Private Ensuite Bathroom)Guest Bedroom 1: Queen Bed (Private Ensuite Bathroom)Guest Bedroom 2: 2 Twin Beds (Private Ensuite Bathroom)3rd Floor:Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed (Private Ensuite Bathroom)Guest Bedroom 4: Queen Bed (Private Ensuite Bathroom)Guest Bedroom 5: Queen Bed (Private Ensuite Bathroom)Guest Bedroom 6: Queen Bed (Private Ensuite Bathroom)Guest Bedroom 7: 2 Twin Beds (Private Ensuite Bathroom)Location: The home sits in Beach Highlands, a small neighborhood on the western end of Dune Allen Beach, right along Scenic Highway 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, FL. Santa Rosa Beach is a broad, unincorporated community that spans much of 30A, encompassing neighborhoods like Dune Allen Beach, Gulf Place, Blue Mountain Beach, and parts of Grayton Beach and WaterColor.Area Attractions: Area Attractions: This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 2.4 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
